findings.summary: The repo scan in endpointGuard.test.ts skipped every directory named design, coverage, .next, .vercel or .claude at any depth, not only the repo-root build and tool folders. A Google call in src/app/design/ (a plausible Next.js route) or src/reports/coverage/ passed npm test and CI. No such folder exists on main or the open PRs today, so nothing is exposed yet.
findings.reproduction: Planted a fetch of the Business Profile account-management API (the #86 plant) in src/app/design/zzplant.ts and src/reports/coverage/zzplant.ts on main: guard 26/26 passed. The same file in src/x/ failed as expected. After the fix the src/app/design plant fails the repo scan. Plants removed.
findings.fix: skipDir() in src/google/endpointGuard.ts: node_modules and .git skipped at any depth; .next, .claude, .vercel, coverage and design only at the repo root. The test's walker uses it.
regression_tests: scans source in nested folders that share a name with a skipped root folder (temp-dir tree; failed with the old name-based skip, passes now)

observations.summary: docs/SPEC.md's FR-9 Implementation status row (from #89) still says 'Implemented, one failure-path gap (noncompliant)', 'test in open #88' and 'fix in open #87'; both merged, so on main the gap A-82-1 is fixed and T-82-1 is pinned. Header and table still say synced at 9d771e1. The FR-2a row does not mention #91's CRLF handling (O-41-2 closed). The Doc still needs the #80, #82, #86 and #89 edits listed in docs/sync/proposed-spec-changes.md.
The guard checks paths, not HTTP methods (DELETE on the post-reply path would pass); businessProfile.test.ts checks methods for today's calls. Owner to decide whether the guard should pin methods.

Provider notes say 'one Google client module that exposes only list reviews and post reply; no other endpoint is called anywhere', but the SPEC also requires the Sheets read (FR-2a) and the landing page loads Google Fonts; the consent and revoke endpoints (connect step, FR-20) are not listed. The guard allows the first two. Recommend the note say it covers the owner's Business Profile grant and list these exceptions.
